scope: Targeted independent red-team of R317 gate-conditioned truncated-Gaussian compression claim; primary mathematical sources only.

substantive_correction_to_r317.statement: A single generic correlated Gaussian orthant probability is not inherently exponential: randomized polynomial-time approximation/sampling algorithms exist.
substantive_correction_to_r317.reason: Those algorithms answer one orthant/convex-set query or return restricted-Gaussian samples; they do not supply a reusable polynomial-size non-Gaussian state closed under subsequent arbitrary dense ReLU layers.

candidate_theorems.source: Kannan and Li, Sampling According to the Multivariate Normal Density, FOCS 1996
candidate_theorems.reason: single-query/sampling result, not all-mask propagated moment compression; finite-support sampling is an already occupied estimator family

candidate_theorems.source: Cousins and Vempala, A Cubic Algorithm for Computing Gaussian Volume, SODA 2014
candidate_theorems.theorem: For convex K satisfying the theorem's roundness assumption, (1+epsilon) Gaussian-volume approximation with probability 1-p in O(n^3 log n log^3(n/epsilon) log(1/p)/epsilon^2); restricted Gaussian first sample O*(n^3), later samples O*(n^2).
assumptions: stated Gaussian-volume theorem requires K containing a unit ball
accuracy epsilon and failure probability p
candidate_theorems.reason: one convex-set query/sampler; no composable all-mask state; no FlopScope or residual-time theorem; stated roundness theorem does not directly match a Gaussian centered at an orthant apex

candidate_theorems.source: Huang, Cao, Fang, Genton, Keyes, Turkiyyah, O(N) TMVN I, Adv Comput Math 2021
candidate_theorems.type: structured exact/numerical hierarchical TMVN expectation algorithm
candidate_theorems.stated_complexity: O(N), prefactor controlled by off-diagonal block rank and effective variables
assumptions: worked rigorous cases include tridiagonal precision / exponential covariance
candidate_theorems.reason: generic dense W C W^T has no guaranteed hierarchical low-rank/low-effective-dimensional precision or covariance structure

candidate_theorems.source: Zheng, Tang, Huang, Wu, O(N) TMVN II, Adv Comput Math 2022
candidate_theorems.stated_complexity: all total-order <=M moments O(N^M) for M>=2; first moments O(N log N)
assumptions: sparse-grid extension aimed at K+P about 5-20
candidate_theorems.limitation: paper states no practical tools known when K+P>20 truly independent variables
candidate_theorems.reason: structural assumptions are not established for generic dense contest layers

candidate_theorems.source: Cao, Genton, Keyes, Turkiyyah, Hierarchical-block conditioning approximations, Stat Comput 2019
candidate_theorems.limitation: primary paper explicitly states absence of an internal approximation-error estimate for tuning
candidate_theorems.reason: not a rigorous controlled approximation for generic dense covariance; empirical spatial-statistics error is not a contest-wide bound

candidate_theorems.source: Cao, Genton, Keyes, Turkiyyah, Exploiting Low Rank Covariance Structures, Stat Comput 2021
candidate_theorems.reason: structural assumption not guaranteed for generic dense layers; stochastic/QMC family already occupied

candidate_theorems.source: Kan and Robotti, On Moments of Folded and Truncated Multivariate Normal Distributions, JCGS 2017
candidate_theorems.reason: efficient local evaluation of moments for one specified truncation is not a polynomial-size representation of all gate-conditioned states through depth

candidate_theorems.source: Macdonald and Waeldchen, A Complete Characterisation of ReLU-Invariant Distributions, AISTATS/PMLR 2022
candidate_theorems.theorem: For a continuous finite-parameter ReLU-invariant family under x->ReLU(Wx+b), one of d=1, finite support, or non-locally-Lipschitz parametrization is necessary.
candidate_theorems.reason: the theorem's invariance class includes arbitrary biases and addresses exact invariance, whereas relevant ARC lanes are bias-free and R321 also asks about controlled approximations

generic_dense_structure_check.formula: For SPD C and arbitrary SPD target S, W=S^(1/2) C^(-1/2) gives W C W^T=S.
generic_dense_structure_check.consequence: An unrestricted dense square affine transport can span arbitrary SPD covariance; hierarchical block rank, tridiagonal precision, Markov sparsity, spatial covariance, bounded K+P, or bounded treewidth cannot be assumed uniformly from the architecture.

orientation_only.caveat: Excludes theorem logarithms/constants/oracle costs and is not a FlopScope bound; no justified epsilon-to-final-MSE mapping exists.

E114_E119.rule: activation-boundary exact-state family already occupied; no new certified compression theorem found

final_reason: Primary literature contains polynomial-time single-orthant algorithms and fast structured-TMVN methods, but no audited theorem simultaneously provides generic-dense validity, non-sampling polynomial-size propagated gate-conditioned state, composable exact/rigorous error control, and a derivable Phase-2 FLOP/residual bound.
